newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Interros Oil wins 34 pct SIDANKO oil stake.
newsitem.headline: Russian Interros Oil wins 34 pct SIDANKO oil stake.

text.p: A 34 percent stake in Russia's NK SIDANKO oil company went to ZAO Interros Oil for 326.1 billion roubles ($60.6 million) in an investment tender on Thursday, a SIDANKO spokesman said.
He said Interros Oil beat out the only other bidder, Alfa-Eko, which bid 325.5 billion roubles.
In the sale, which was closed to foreigners, the State Property Fund offered 79.023 million SIDANKO shares worth 110 billion roubles.
The minimum required investment was 325.1 billion roubles.
The spokesman said Interros Oil's main activities were marketing, consulting and investments.
He declined to say whether Interros Oil was related to the finance-industrial group Interros.

The finance-industrial group Interros, set up in 1994, includes Uneximbank, AKB Mezhdunarodnaya Finansovaya Kompaniya (MFK), the petrochemicals plants Irgiz and Fosforit, as well as metals plants Norilsky Nikel and the Kuznetsky Metallurgichesky Kombinat.
Under the rules of the tender, the winner must transfer to SIDANKO at least 13 percent of the capital of SIDANKO subsidiary AO Chernogorneft.
SIDANKO said in February that around 15 percent of Chernogorneft had been purchased by the MFK and MFK-Moskovskie Partnery banks.
SIDANKO's shares each have a nominal value of 40 roubles.
MFK bank, backed by Uneximbank, acquired 51 percent of SIDANKO at a shares-for-loans auction last year.
SIDANKO's 1995 pre-tax profit was 2.12 trillion roubles.
